subject: prd/planner-driven-model-routing
statement: When a resolved implementation or review route reaches a terminal worker state, the system shall connect exactly one `verified`, `failed`, or `blocked` outcome and its available usage measurements to that routing decision.
rationale: resolved routes need an achievable outcome chain distinct from pre-claim failures
fit_criterion: every EVT-2 in conformance and dogfood joins exactly one EVT-5; EVT-3 terminal failures require no EVT-5
